Customization.title: Customization
Customization.body: Customization shows in one place what this workspace records beyond what TILL ships with: custom fields and shared views, per entity kind. Fields and views carry separate permissions, so a role may maintain one and only read the other. A field proposed by an agent stays a marked draft with no effect until a person releases it.
